name: Too Cool Connection

tenures.source: Billed World Tag Team Champions from Calgary, Alberta, entering the 6 October 1999 broadcast; lost the title there.

caption: A Calgary tag team billed as World Tag Team Champions for the whole of this record until a distracted referee's missed count cost them the title.

name: The Dark Forces

tenures.source: Won the World Tag Team Championship from the Too Cool Connection on 6 October 1999.

caption: A tag team from the stable Razor's From Dollywood that won the World Tag Team Championship on its only appearance in this record.

name: Razor's From Dollywood

tenures.source: Named on-air as holding, between its members, the World Heavyweight, World Tag Team and Cruiserweight Championships after the Dark Forces' own title win.

caption: A stable whose members held every title in the promotion but one by the end of this record.
